WITH latest_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        ProductKey,
        max(DateKey) AS max_date
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey
),
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        i.ProductKey,
        sum(i.OnHandQuantity) AS current_on_hand_quantity
    FROM retail.FactInventory AS i
    INNER JOIN latest_inventory AS li
        ON i.StoreKey = li.StoreKey
       AND i.ProductKey = li.ProductKey
       AND i.DateKey = li.max_date
    GROUP BY i.ProductKey
),
sales_90d AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        sum(SalesQuantity) / 90.0 AS avg_daily_sales_quantity_90d
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE DateKey BETWEEN toDate('2009-10-03') AND toDate('2009-12-31')
    GROUP BY ProductKey
)
SELECT
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    ci.current_on_hand_quantity,
    s.avg_daily_sales_quantity_90d,
    ci.current_on_hand_quantity / nullIf(s.avg_daily_sales_quantity_90d, 0) AS days_inventory_coverage
FROM current_inventory AS ci
INNER JOIN sales_90d AS s
    ON ci.ProductKey = s.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON ci.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE s.avg_daily_sales_quantity_90d > 0
ORDER BY days_inventory_coverage ASC
LIMIT 20
